title: mespilus oxyacantha var. obtusata
intro: Mespilus oxyacantha var. obtusata, commonly known as the Wild Service Tree, is a deciduous tree or shrub belonging to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of Wild Service Tree include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and have a potential anti-diabetic effect. The bioactive constituents of Mespilus oxyacantha var. obtusata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
